normalized_input.student_answer_text:
求特征值：
由特征方程 $|\lambda I - A| = 0$，得:
$|\lambda I - A| = \begin{vmatrix}\lambda - 2 & -1 \\-1 & \lambda - 2\end{vmatrix} = (\lambda - 2)^2 - 1 = 0$
$(\lambda - 2)^2 = 1$
$\lambda - 2 = \pm 1$
$\lambda_1 = 1, \lambda_2 = 3$
求特征向量：
当 $\lambda_1 = 1$ 时:
$(\lambda I - A)x = 0$，即 $\begin{pmatrix}-1 & -1 \\-1 & -1\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}x_1 \\x_2\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}0 \\0\end{pmatrix}$
得 $-x_1 - x_2 = 0$，即 $x_1 = -x_2$
令 $x_2 = k$，则 $x_1 = -k$，特征向量为 $k(1, -1)^T (k \neq 0)$
当 $\lambda_2 = 3$ 时:
$(\lambda I - A)x = 0$，即 $\begin{pmatrix}1 & -1 \\-1 & 1\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}x_1 \\x_2\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}0 \\0\end{pmatrix}$
